reviews.title: Beautiful, Compact, and Great to Use
reviews.comment:
I really like this mouse.
It looks clean, minimal, and very premium. The design is beautiful, and it fits perfectly with a well-organized home office setup. It’s compact but still feels solid and high quality.
The clicks are very pleasant and quiet, and overall it works smoothly and reliably for everyday use.
In my case, my computer didn’t have Bluetooth, so I paired it using the Logitech Bolt receiver, and it works perfectly.
Overall, it’s a great combination of design, comfort, and quality. It also pairs really nicely with my keyboards and the overall aesthetic of my workspace.
Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Alexander

reviews.title: Best mouse for work or casual settings
reviews.comment:
Very good mouse
-The battery lasts insanely long. I have been using it for over 20 hours, and it has only lost 10%. It automatically goes into sleep after some time of no use, so I dont need to worry about it dying if i leave it on by accident.
-Very quiet. The clicking is soft and barely noticeable. The scroll wheel is very quiet too
-Nice feel. It has soft edges and a pleasant grip. My hand does not cramp or become sore, even after hours of use
-Has two customizable buttons by the thumb. By default they are undo/redo, and I keep it as such
-Scroll wheel can switch between smooth scrolling and a “clicky” scroll.
-Works on all surfaces. I have yet to find a surface it does not track on, including a blanket or my own thigh
-No lag. I have not had any issues with delay or connection issues
-Easy to connect and can easily switch between devices with the button on the bottom
-Stays clean. I have had issues with some mice accumulating grime (I am a clean person, it just happens from oils or dust). This mouse does not collect any grime
Overall, I love it. It took me a second to adjust to the size, since it is smaller than my previous mouse. I would not go back. Very happy with it
reviews.author: Coral Wooten

reviews.title: Excellent Small Mouse With A Couple Of Flaws
reviews.comment:
The Logitech MX Anywhere 3S is a compact mouse that feels surprisingly premium for its size. The plastic body has a solid, high‑quality feel—lightweight but not cheap—and it holds up well during long work sessions. The quiet clicks are one of the standout features; they’re soft, muted, and perfect for shared spaces or late‑night use. The scroll wheel is also excellent, especially with its ability to automatically switch between tactile step‑scrolling and smooth free‑spin. It makes moving through long documents or spreadsheets feel effortless.
Where the mouse falls short is in the side buttons. They’re positioned in a way that makes them a bit finicky to use, and even once you get them configured, they don’t consistently work across all applications. It’s frustrating when you expect a back/forward action and nothing happens. Another drawback is that Logitech now requires a new software program to configure the mouse. Even if you’ve used their older devices, you still have to download and set up this new software, which feels unnecessary and adds extra steps.
Overall, it’s a great little mouse with excellent build quality and smooth performance, but the side button behavior and software requirement keep it from being perfect.
reviews.author: Max

reviews.title: Great little mouse and I love it, but...
reviews.comment:
I Love these mice for my main PC and other PC's.  They are smaller and have a nice weight to them.  They used to be a little heavier so I liked those better.
The mouse stays charged up probably about 90-days and I've had it for a couple years already.  Also the reception is good and no issues with me on any computer.
The bad part is, (and there's always a bad part) the dumb rubber they put on the sides.  It always becomes sticky and gross feeling.  I used to wash my mouse with spray foam window cleaner and that got it very clean.  I've always done that.  I like a very clean mouse and can not stand any stickyness on it.  One mouse I had before this one but same model, I took masking tape and taped over the rubber.  That became the greatest mouse.  I wish they would sell them without the rubber.  Bad #2 is the left mouse button on these mice, and maybe all Logitech mice will go bad and do unpredictable double-clicks, randomly drop things when you're draging them then you spend a half day trying to find where they went.  When the double-click issue begins (and it will), it's unfixable and you must buy a new mouse.  I have kept purchasing these because there’s nothing on the market to match them, so to me it’s worth it to get a new one every once in a while.  Look up logitech double-click issues on google.  There is a lot of reading to do out there but unfortunately Logitech doesn’t seem to read reviews.
I do reccomend this mouse with a 5 STAR rating knowing the rubber becomes sticky and the left button gives trouble after some time.
TO LOGITECH: Please make a version of this mouse that just has the same slick finish over the whole mouse, and LEAVE OFF THE DEGRADING RUBBER.
reviews.author: Top Ranked Reviewer

reviews.title: Seems like a good mouse, but doesn't have tilt-scrolling.
reviews.comment:
Great features - Bluetooth up to (3) devices. There is no USB dongle needed for the 3rd device like the Triathlon....and it really feels like a great pairing to MX Keys. It has hyper scroll, rechargeable internal (non-removable) battery. Feels solid. It just doesn't have tilt-scrolling, which I really am used to using in my work-flow when navigating Excel sheets. There is an option within the software (Options+) to use the side buttons+wheel for horizontal scrolling. However, when this is selected, it disables the ability to use side buttons for Volume Up and Volume Down....which is another critical feature to have, being able to adjust headset volume on the fly, whilst conducting my side-scrolling business.
Texture and feel match MX Keys Attire. It's listed as a compact mouse...seems like it would do well with travel. It's not tiny compared to my hands....but if you are spending all day, everyday and you have big hands, you probably aren't going to like the feel that much. Other than my tilt-scrolling wheel peeve, there isn't much to hate for this compact traveler.
